title: Adjunction field for the integral tensor presentation
statement: For the closed structure S and its symmetric braiding β, there is an adjunction in the tensor parameter for every derived object K, with left functor S.tensor curried at K and right functor the recorded derived internal Hom curried at op K.

proof.text: Install the supplied monoidal structure S.monoidal and symmetric structure beta as local instances. For each K, identify tensorLeft K with the curried S.tensor at K by identity components. Naturality is the identity-tensor equation id_tensorHom, together with identity composition.

The field S.adjunction K has left functor tensorRight K and right functor the recorded internal Hom at op K. Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft to the inverse of BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight K, followed by the identity-component comparison just constructed. The curried internal-Hom functor is definitionally Prod.sectR (op K) followed by H. Package these adjunctions for all K in Nonempty.
